items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: when I went with Lonzo and whatever, you know, when I tell you, when I was going around serenading

ctx.x: But when did you play mandolin?

Oh, I had been playing mandolin, uh, I think that's, uh, the same time I started playing guitar, picked up the mandolin too. Mm-hmm. Yeah, both, same time, when I went with Lonzo and whatever, you know, when I tell you, when I was going around serenading, I just started picking up mandolin like that, and got a hold of one, and, and, uh, somehow or another, this app like that, and got to, got to be a good mandolin player. And, uh, I could play anything I want on it. Just by here. If I could hear a number, I could…
Uh, uh, I wish you'd explain to me about the guitar style on those days. Did they play with a pick or with, same as thumb picks or flat pick? Yeah, use the pick.
